items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I know him. Because he'd play violin... He was good.

ctx.x: He's even thinking of starting to play the string bass. Yeah.

George Foster. You know him, don't you? Bass player. And he had a brother named, uh, Willie. Charlie! Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. Willie, yeah. White fella. Yeah, yeah. I know him. Because he'd play violin, and he'd get up a violin once there and get a ten of banjo. He was the best runner on a ten of banjo. But he didn't play so long, you know. He was in Baton Rouge, you see. He was in the Blaster and Bricklay, you know. He was…
Ask him who were some of the bands in Baton Rouge.
